title: UGC Style Product Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Make creator-style product photos for your image ads. Add one clear product photo, choose an everyday scene, and download a still without booking a creator.
h1: Make UGC Style Product Photos for Ads
lead: Make UGC-style product photos in minutes, without booking a creator or arranging a shoot. Try more everyday scenes from the same product photo.
steps_h2: How to Make a UGC Style Photo in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Start with your product, choose an everyday setting, and download a still image ready for your next image ad.

steps.d: Upload a clear image of the product you sell, or paste its product page as the starting point.
Choose a natural setting and describe how the product should appear in the still image.
Check the product and scene, then download the image for your feed or ad. One image costs 24 credits.

faq.q: What comes with a monthly plan?
faq.a: Your plan includes a credit balance for making product images and other supported ads. Starter is $24.50 for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600 each month.

faq.q: What can I change in a creator-style photo?
faq.a: Choose the setting, crop, product placement, and overall look. Review the result before you use it in an ad.

faq.q: How many credits does one UGC-style image use?
faq.a: One generated image uses 24 credits. You see the cost before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Do unused credits carry into the next month?
faq.a: Check the rollover terms in your account before renewal. Credits from a failed image job return to your balance.

faq.q: Can I use the same photo for another market?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the product photo and add a caption in the language your shoppers use when you publish the image.

faq.q: Can I change the image before I download it?
faq.a: Yes. Adjust the scene or crop before you save it. A newly generated version uses credits.

faq.q: Does my plan include a monthly credit balance?
faq.a: Yes. Starter, Pro, and Premium each show the monthly amount in your account.

faq.q: Can I change plans from my account?
faq.a: Yes. Switch between Starter, Pro, and Premium in your account when your image needs change.

faq.q: Will changing plans create a second balance?
faq.a: No. Your account shows the balance for the plan you use, rather than a separate balance for each plan.

faq.q: Can I stop my plan before the next bill?
faq.a: Yes. Cancel or change your plan in your account before the next billing date.

faq.q: Can I use these images on my store and in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use the downloaded still in your store, social posts, or paid image ads. Check product details and ad claims before publishing.

faq.q: What happens if an image job fails?
faq.a: Its credits return to your balance. For other refund questions, read the [Refund Policy](/refunds).

faq.q: Can a product link start a creator-style image?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product page you control, then review the product details and image before downloading.

faq.q: Can I edit the result after it is made?
faq.a: Yes. Adjust the image before download. If you need motion later, try [creator-style video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: Which files can I add at the start?
faq.a: Start with a clear product photo or a product link. Add reference images you have permission to use when you need them.
